_notes.source: Live https://fundedfuturesnetwork.com/accounts read in Chrome on 2026-10-20 (MAX Standard and Steady, every size, Nexus and Rithmic/Onyx platform options), /affiliate-program and Google Maps. Earlier sources (2026-10-11) listed in git history.
_notes.pricing: standard = full one-time evaluation price (crossed out). promo = the discounted price shown on 2026-10-20 with the Rithmic/Onyx platform selected: 50% off (plus 'Buy 1, Get 1 Free' on Onyx). With the Nexus Trader / Nexus Connect platform the discount is 70% (e.g. MAX Standard 50K $53.40, Steady 25K $44.70). The discount is applied through a creator's referral code pre-applied on every visit (see promo_code_note). Steady now shows discounted prices too: $74.50 / $114.50 / $154 / $292.50 / $375. Full prices unchanged.
_notes.promo_code_note: FFN's site pre-applies KSWART, a referral code belonging to a named creator. We decided (2026-10-11) not to display another affiliate's code, so promo_code is null and the discount shows as 'current promo'.
_notes.billing: One-time evaluation fee, no activation fee after passing. Evaluation reset fee: MAX Standard $100; Steady $114 / $180 / $270 / $480 / $620. One-time funded reset before any payout: $475 / $625 / $1,250 / $1,875 / $3,125.
_notes.skip_the_eval: Optional 'Skip the Eval' add-on is sold per size at checkout (MAX Standard $279-$2,550, Steady $299-$2,700). Not listed as a separate program.
_notes.rules_detail: Both plans: EOD trailing drawdown that locks at starting balance + $100 on the funded account; same-day payouts; $500 minimum payout; live review after 4 payouts on one account or 10 since the last review; per-user cap of $10,000 per payout across all accounts. MAX Standard: daily loss limit in evaluation and funded, 5 minimum trading days ($100-$300 profit each, by size), 40% consistency in evaluation and funded, 80% split. Steady: no daily loss limit (the page says 'None'), 2 minimum trading days ($100-$350 each), 52% consistency in the evaluation, no consistency rule on the funded account, 90% split, 5 winning days per payout.
_notes.contract_scaling: MAX Standard funded accounts scale contracts with profit (e.g. 50K: 2 minis up to $1,000 profit, 3 up to $2,000, then 4). max_contracts records the full limit.
_notes.fee_refund: No official page we could read says whether fees are refunded, so null.
_notes.countries: FFN's country list is in its help centre (fundedfuturesnetwork.zendesk.com article 47386113405083), which blocks automated access. Not recorded.
_notes.company: Funded Futures Network LLC, 99 Wall Street #1660, New York NY 10006 (about page and footer). Founded 2022 per the site ('In Business Since 2022').
_notes.vetting: Checked 2026-10-11. Trustpilot 3.8 from 532 reviews. 3 of the 20 newest reviews described a delayed or refused payout. Passed.
_notes.marketing_stats_excluded: '259,300+ accounts' and 'paid out millions' are not reproduced.
_notes.rule_units: Futures rules are fixed USD amounts per account size.
_notes.null_means: Not stated on an official FFN page we could read.
_notes.affiliate_program: https://fundedfuturesnetwork.com/affiliate-program (2026-10-20): 15% commission on every account purchase through the affiliate's link or promo code; payouts requested from the affiliate dashboard. Cookie length, payout method, minimum payout, country and comparison-site rules are not stated. Applications are reviewed. Apply: https://dashboard.fundedfuturesnetwork.com/affiliate/apply
_notes.google_rating: Google Maps (2026-10-20): 'Funded Futures Network' listing (category 'Educational testing service', website fundedfuturesnetwork.com, phone +1 917-310-0292) - 4.0 from 4 reviews.

firm.name: Funded Futures Network
firm.about: Funded Futures Network (FFN) is a New York-based futures prop firm started in 2022 by a group of traders. It sells one-time-fee evaluations from $25K to $250K in two styles: MAX Standard, which has a daily loss limit, and Steady, which has no daily loss limit but a consistency rule during the evaluation.

countries.notes: FFN publishes its country list in its help centre, which we couldn't open. Not recorded yet.
